executive_summary: Tropicash has a substantial Next.js + Supabase fintech stack with working soft-launch wallet flows (PayPal funding, P2P send, withdrawal queue), extensive admin/compliance tooling, and a mature sandbox developer platform. The platform is not production-ready for regulated live-money deployment. Critical gaps include missing fund_wallet SQL migration in version control, balance vs wallet_balance column split across RPCs, advisory-only KYC enforcement, open fraud_logs RLS, single hardcoded admin RBAC, draft legal documents, PayPal sandbox defaults, absent QR/payment links/merchant checkout, and no automated webhook delivery pipeline. Suitable for internal testing with manual treasury oversight; not ready for Private Alpha with real money until P0 blockers are resolved.
scoring_method: Module scores (0-100) derived from code inspection, existing audit tooling (productionAudit.js, complianceChecklist.js, launchReadiness.js), and operational posture. Overall score is unweighted average of 31 production modules.

modules.name: Authentication
modules.summary: Supabase email/password auth, password reset, session lifecycle, and RouteAuthGuard. No 2FA enforcement, no social OAuth for users, client-side route protection only.

modules.name: Authorization
modules.summary: Single hardcoded admin email allowlist. OAuth scope RBAC for developers. No role matrix, admin pages gated client-side only.

modules.name: User Onboarding
modules.summary: Auth signup/login, KYC document upload, soft-launch notices. No guided tour, no email verification beyond Supabase defaults.

modules.name: Wallet
modules.summary: Wallet UI, balance display, OAuth sandbox read. Critical balance vs wallet_balance column split across RPCs.

modules.name: Ledger
modules.summary: Double-entry schema and admin UI exist. Observation mode only — no automatic journal posts from money flows.

modules.name: Transactions
modules.summary: Transaction history, filtering, withdrawal correlation. Type mismatch (send vs send_money) in fraud lookups.

modules.name: Funding
modules.summary: PayPal create/capture with idempotency and rate limits. fund_wallet RPC referenced but missing from supabase/sql migrations.

modules.name: Withdrawals
modules.summary: Strongest money flow. Atomic RPC, KYC server gate, manual review default, optional PayPal payout automation.

modules.name: Merchant Platform
modules.summary: Config/catalog only. No checkout sessions, settlement, or merchant onboarding APIs.

modules.name: QR Payments
modules.summary: No QR generation, scanning, or checkout flows found in codebase.

modules.name: Payment Links
modules.summary: No hosted payment link product. Closest is planned checkout session contract in developer catalog.

modules.name: Notifications
modules.summary: In-app Supabase notifications with realtime. No push, email, or SMS delivery layer.

modules.name: Security
modules.summary: Rate limits, hashed secrets, PayPal webhook verification, audit trails. No CSRF, CSP, fail-open account security, fraud RLS wide open.

modules.name: Fraud Controls
modules.summary: Rule-based detection, trust layer client caps, admin queue. Engine is log-only; send bypasses server gates; fraud_logs RLS allows all authenticated users.

modules.name: KYC
modules.summary: Document upload, admin review, limit policies. Default advisory enforcement; funding/send unguarded server-side; no identity vendor.

modules.name: AML Controls
modules.summary: Draft AML policy only. No sanctions/PEP screening, no SAR workflow, no automated AML monitoring.

modules.name: Treasury
modules.summary: Rich admin dashboard, intelligence, event center. Advisory/simulation layers; no automated settlement; ledger not connected.

modules.name: Admin Console
modules.summary: 44 admin pages covering KYC, fraud, treasury, withdrawals, launch readiness, developer sandbox. Single admin email RBAC.

modules.name: Reporting
modules.summary: Withdrawal reconciliation, launch readiness scoring, production audit, compliance checklist. Read-only; no scheduled exports.

modules.name: Developer APIs
modules.summary: Sandbox-only read APIs (ping, profile, currencies). No money-movement APIs. Production keys not issuable.

modules.name: OAuth
modules.summary: Full OAuth2 stack for developers with hashed tokens, scopes, certification gates. Sandbox only; code issuance feature-flagged off.

modules.name: SDK Readiness
modules.summary: In-repo @tropicash/sdk v0.1.0 private preview. Not published to npm; production env rejected; no TypeScript types.

modules.name: Webhooks
modules.summary: Registration, test delivery, PayPal inbound webhooks. No production event delivery worker; signing key mismatch for developer verification.

modules.name: Mobile Responsiveness
modules.summary: Tailwind responsive utilities across consumer pages. Admin pages partially optimized; viewport meta not explicit in _document.js.

modules.name: PWA
modules.summary: Manifest, service worker (production only), installable shell. Offline explicitly excludes wallet/API routes.

modules.name: Environment Configuration
modules.summary: Runtime env vars functional but no .env.example. PayPal defaults to sandbox. Dual PayPal mode vars risk mismatch.

modules.name: Secrets Management
modules.summary: Show-once secrets, SHA-256 hash storage, service role server-only. Hardcoded admin email; no secrets manager integration.

modules.name: Error Handling
modules.summary: Consistent API envelopes for developer/OAuth routes. Mixed client patterns; no global error middleware or integrator error catalog.

modules.name: Logging
modules.summary: DB-backed operational logs, admin audit, fraud logs, OAuth audit. No centralized aggregation or request tracing.

modules.name: Monitoring
modules.summary: Admin health checks, smart alerts, sandbox monitoring. No Sentry/Datadog/PagerDuty integration.

modules.name: Production Configuration
modules.summary: Minimal next.config.mjs (poweredByHeader false only). No security headers, no deployment runbook, legal pages draft.

critical.title: fund_wallet RPC missing from version-controlled migrations
critical.description: pages/api/paypal/capture-order.js calls supabaseAdmin.rpc('fund_wallet') but no CREATE FUNCTION fund_wallet exists in supabase/sql/.
critical.why_blocks: PayPal capture succeeds but wallet credit fails unless RPC was applied manually outside repo.
critical.recommended_fix: Add fund_wallet SQL migration aligned with wallet_balance column, transaction insert, and idempotency.

critical.title: balance vs wallet_balance column split
critical.description: transfer_funds RPC uses balance column; create_withdrawal_request and funding paths use wallet_balance.
critical.why_blocks: Users may see incorrect balances; send and withdraw can operate on different columns causing data corruption.
critical.recommended_fix: Unify to single column, migrate all RPCs, backfill existing data.

critical.title: KYC enforcement advisory-only by default
critical.description: Funding and send flows have no server-side KYC hard blocks; withdrawal RPC bypassable without check-limit API.
critical.why_blocks: Regulated live-money launch requires enforced identity verification before money movement.
critical.recommended_fix: Enable hard_block enforcement mode; add KYC gate to withdrawal RPC and server APIs for fund/send.

critical.title: No sanctions/PEP screening or SAR workflow
critical.description: AML policy pages state placeholders; no vendor integration or suspicious activity reporting.
critical.why_blocks: Required for MSB/fintech compliance in most jurisdictions before handling customer funds.
critical.recommended_fix: Integrate sanctions screening vendor; implement SAR case workflow in admin console.

critical.title: fraud_logs RLS allows all authenticated users
critical.description: fraud_logs_install.sql policies use USING (true) for select/insert/update by any authenticated user.
critical.why_blocks: Fraud investigation data leak and potential tampering by malicious users.
critical.recommended_fix: Replace dev policies with admin-only RLS via tc_is_admin() or service-role-only access.

critical.title: Single hardcoded admin email RBAC
critical.description: ADMIN_EMAILS hardcoded in lib/adminAccess.js and tc_is_admin() SQL function.
critical.why_blocks: Not scalable, not auditable, admin identity exposed in source; no role separation for ops/compliance/treasury.
critical.recommended_fix: Move to env/DB-backed roles table with granular permissions.

critical.title: Legal documents are draft placeholders
critical.description: Terms, privacy, AML, KYC, risk disclosure pages exist but audit tooling marks all as draft pending legal review.
critical.why_blocks: Cannot launch to external users without legally reviewed policies.
critical.recommended_fix: Complete legal review and update pages; track version/effective date.

critical.title: Send money bypasses server-side gates
critical.description: pages/send-money.jsx calls transfer_funds RPC directly without server KYC/fraud/account security checks.
critical.why_blocks: Client-side trust layer can be bypassed; high-risk transfers possible.
critical.recommended_fix: Add POST /api/send/check-limit mirroring withdrawal gate; enforce in RPC or middleware.

major.title: PayPal defaults to sandbox mode
major.description: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYPAL_MODE unset defaults to sandbox; live credentials not validated in production audit.
major.why_blocks: Real money cannot flow without explicit live cutover and webhook configuration.
major.recommended_fix: Live PayPal cutover checklist; env validation that fails deploy if sandbox in production NODE_ENV.

major.title: No .env.example or deployment runbook
major.description: Zero env template files in repo; README is create-next-app boilerplate.
major.why_blocks: Deployment errors, misconfiguration, secret omissions in production.
major.recommended_fix: Add .env.example documenting all public vs server vars with descriptions.

major.title: 2FA/MFA not enforced
major.description: security_settings.sql schema exists but app explicitly states 2FA not enforced.
major.why_blocks: Wallet API readiness docs require step-up auth for production OAuth wallet access.
major.recommended_fix: Implement TOTP/SMS 2FA with enforcement for financial actions.

major.title: Account security guard fail-open
major.description: serverAccountSecurityGuard returns allow if account_security_status table missing or unreadable.
major.why_blocks: Frozen/restricted accounts may perform financial actions during migration gaps.
major.recommended_fix: Fail-closed for financial actions when status cannot be verified.

major.title: Internal ledger not connected to money flows
major.description: Ledger is observation-only; no auto-posting from fund/withdraw/send.
major.why_blocks: Cannot reconcile treasury liabilities or produce auditable financial statements.
major.recommended_fix: Wire journal entries to all money RPCs or formally designate transactions table as SOA.

major.title: No external APM or alerting
major.description: No Sentry, Datadog, PagerDuty, or uptime monitoring for APIs.
major.why_blocks: Production incidents may go undetected until user reports.
major.recommended_fix: Add Sentry for errors, uptime checks for critical APIs, PagerDuty/Slack alerts.

major.title: No production webhook delivery pipeline
major.description: Only developer.test events; test signing uses secret_hash not plaintext whsec shown to developers.
major.why_blocks: Third-party integrators cannot receive real payment/wallet events.
major.recommended_fix: Build delivery worker with encrypted secret storage and retry logic.

major.title: Legacy tropicash-api Python sidecar
major.description: tropicash-api/main.py exposes wallet mutations with simple API_SECRET_KEY auth.
major.why_blocks: Parallel mutation path bypasses Next.js security gates if deployed.
major.recommended_fix: Remove or fully isolate behind internal network with deprecation plan.

minor.title: Transaction type mismatch send vs send_money
minor.description: transfer_funds inserts type='send' but fraud lookup queries send_money.
minor.why_blocks: Fraud correlation and notifications may miss send transactions.
minor.recommended_fix: Standardize on send_money across RPC and queries.

minor.title: No CSRF protection on API routes
minor.description: No CSRF tokens; OAuth recommends state param only.
minor.why_blocks: Cross-site request forgery risk for cookie-based flows.
minor.recommended_fix: Add CSRF tokens for state-changing browser-initiated requests.

minor.title: No security headers (CSP, HSTS)
minor.why_blocks: Reduced defense-in-depth against XSS and clickjacking.

minor.title: SDK not published to npm
minor.description: @tropicash/sdk is private, UNLICENSED, no CI tests.
minor.why_blocks: External developers cannot install official SDK.
minor.recommended_fix: Publish to npm with TypeScript types and test suite.

minor.title: No email/push notification delivery
minor.description: In-app only; no FCM/APNs or transactional email.
minor.why_blocks: Users miss critical security and transaction alerts when offline.
minor.recommended_fix: Add SendGrid/Resend for email; optional push via FCM.

minor.title: PWA offline shell only
minor.description: Service worker explicitly excludes wallet/API; offline page says wallet unavailable.
minor.recommended_fix: Accept as v1 limitation or expand offline capabilities.

informational.title: QR payments not implemented
informational.description: No QR code generation, scanning, or payment flows.
informational.why_blocks: Feature gap for in-person payments — not required for wallet-only Private Alpha.

informational.title: Payment links not implemented
informational.description: No shareable checkout URLs for merchants or individuals.
informational.why_blocks: Feature gap — defer unless required for launch scope.

informational.title: Merchant checkout simulation only
informational.description: Developer catalog has planned checkout session contracts; no live routes.
informational.recommended_fix: Phase 5 roadmap item; not blocking wallet-only Private Alpha.

informational.title: No scheduled report exports
informational.description: Reporting is read-only admin UI; no CSV/PDF export or BI integration.
informational.recommended_fix: Add export endpoints for reconciliation and audit reports.

recommended_implementation_order: Phase 1 (Week 1-2): BLK-001 fund_wallet migration, BLK-002 balance unification, BLK-005 fraud RLS, BLK-010 .env.example
Phase 2 (Week 2-3): BLK-008 send server gate, BLK-003 KYC hard enforcement, BLK-012 fail-closed account security, BLK-006 admin RBAC
Phase 3 (Week 3-4): BLK-009 PayPal live cutover, BLK-007 legal review, BLK-016 remove legacy API, BLK-014 monitoring
Phase 4 (Week 4-8): BLK-004 AML vendor, BLK-011 2FA, BLK-013 ledger wiring, BLK-015 webhook pipeline
Phase 5 (Post Private Alpha): QR payments, payment links, merchant platform, SDK npm publish

prerequisites: All P0 blockers resolved (BLK-001 through BLK-008)
PayPal live mode with webhooks verified
KYC hard_block enabled for withdrawals and sends
Admin RBAC with at least 2 operators
exit_criteria: End-to-end fund → send → withdraw works on live PayPal with zero balance discrepancies
All money RPCs version-controlled and applied to production Supabase
Compliance checklist scores ≥70% on KYC, security, fraud categories
No CRITICAL open fraud_logs accessible to non-admin users
Production audit passes Supabase, PayPal live, and legal probes
